prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: minimal audio-flag toolbar glyph for an audiobook app, readable at 26 pixels.
Draw a single clean flat LINE ICON: a short straight vertical flag pole and an outlined rectangular flag with a small V-cut at the right edge. Inside the flag are three short rounded vertical audio waveform bars, center bar tallest. The whole glyph is one solid uniform warm ochre color #dfbd7d. Center it on a square canvas with 10 percent margin.
Use crisp flat 2D icon geometry, even monoline weight, smooth rounded ends. Nothing ornamental. It is a UI symbol, not a physical metallic object.
Background: perfectly solid pure black #000000 everywhere outside the gold lines and bars, also pure black inside the flag around the bars. Opaque RGB output. No transparency is needed.
Absolutely NO gradients, speckles, texture, grain, particles, lighting, shadows, shine, glow, three-dimensional depth, button outline, text, letters or numbers. One simple flat gold-on-black icon only.
webExport: 96px PNG export from the unchanged ImageGen original, using macOS sips; displayed at32px for 3x pixel density
